changes: First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54: two more filter TYPEs on the stock FLTR page, after EQ:5.
DJ: one knob from a low-pass on the left through open in the middle to a high-pass on the right, with a short catch in the middle; FUNC + FREQ jumps there.
BP: a band-pass at unity gain whose width RESO sets.
Both are saved with the sound and take p-locks and LFOs like the stock types. A sound with DJ or BP loads as EQ:5 without the module.
Known issue: it cannot be combined with Digi Health, which patches the same filter call.
